title: Kessler Shield Coverage Schedule — Component Groups by Level
content:
**Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts — what each coverage level covers.** A failure is covered only when its component group is marked covered for the contract's level.

| Component group (what it includes) | Powertrain | Powertrain Plus | Select | Preferred | Exclusionary | Exclusionary Wrap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Engine (internally lubricated engine parts) | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Transmission (transmission and transfer case) | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Drive axle (front and rear drive axle assemblies) | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Cooling (water pump, radiator, thermostat) | — | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Fuel system (fuel pump, injectors, fuel pressure regulator) | — | — | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Electrical (alternator, starter, power window and lock motors, wiring harnesses) | — | — | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Air conditioning (compressor, condenser, evaporator) | — | — | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Steering (steering gear, rack, power steering pump) | — | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |
| Suspension (control arms, ball joints, bushings) | — | — | — | covered | covered | covered |
| Brakes (master cylinder, calipers, ABS module; pads, shoes and rotors never) | — | — | — | covered | covered | covered |
| High-tech electronics (infotainment, navigation, camera, driver-assist modules) | — | — | — | — | covered | covered |
| Seals and gaskets of covered components | — | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered |

**Exclusions at every level.** No level covers wear and maintenance items. Every level excludes failures present before the contract was sold.

**Internally lubricated components.** The engine, transmission and drive axle groups are the internally lubricated ones. The other nine groups are not.

**Reading the table (hypothetical).**
- A failed water pump falls in the cooling group. It is covered under Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus and above, not under Kessler Shield Powertrain.
- Worn brake pads are never covered.
- A failed ABS module is covered under Kessler Shield Preferred, Exclusionary and Exclusionary Wrap.
